stem: Wendy’s journey to work consists of three parts: walking to the train station, riding on the train and then walking to the office. The times, in minutes, for the three parts of her journey are independent and have the distributions $\text{N}(15.0, 1.1^2)$, $\text{N}(32.0, 3.5^2)$ and $\text{N}(8.6, 1.2^2)$ respectively.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the mean and variance of the total time for Wendy’s journey.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: If Wendy’s journey takes more than 60 minutes, she is late for work.
parts.text: Find the probability that, on a randomly chosen day, Wendy will be late for work.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Find the probability that the mean of Wendy’s journey times over 15 randomly chosen days will be less than 54.5 minutes.
